blurb: The Dance Academy Del Mar provides dance education for students from two months old through adults, offering a wide range of dance styles and programs. The studio is affiliated with the Royal Academy of Dance and offers internationally recognized ballet curriculum and examinations. Adult classes include ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop, salsa, and more, with no prior experience required.
